title: Unit Event — From the Marks Left Behind — Episode7 Technical Difficulties?!

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! starts looking at candidates for their new home base, the MORE MORE HOUSE. However, finding a place that fits their criteria proves rather difficult...

rows.Line: TV Station - Studio

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Technical difficulties... Missing forty minutes of footage puts us in a tough situation.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm surprised this kind of thing happened at a TV studio during a shoot...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too. I've heard of stuff like this happening, but this is my first time actually being on site as it did...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is the stuff of nightmares to the camera crew since such a simple mistake can cascade into fairly serious problems for the show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't imagine...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(But this is really happening...
What does that mean for our shoot...?)
se_run_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Kuromiya
rows.Line: Thank you all very much for your patience! As you probably just heard, we're having some technical issues...

rows.Speaker: Kuromiya
rows.Line: To summarize, I'm very sorry, but we'll have to reshoot everything we just did following the break...

rows.Speaker: MYU
rows.Line: Yes, I had a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which means we'll have to do MYU's segment all over again, including trying the food.

rows.Speaker: Yuika
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm not so sure about this now...
We're going to sound really phony if we're not careful...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...!
We have to act like it's our first time trying them...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The audience is also going to have to sit through it again...

rows.Speaker: MYU
rows.Line: There's something else that's worrying me...

rows.Speaker: MYU
rows.Line: The packaging for everything that I brought in has been opened up. How do we make them look like new?

rows.Speaker: MYU
rows.Line: Worse, we went through most of what we had. They're in our stomachs now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: MYU
rows.Line: So, I'm not sure we can redo my segment... We might want to try shooting something else.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Something else...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. We can't really do a segment about delectables that we don't have...

rows.Speaker: Kuromiya
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
I was hoping that we could come up with a solution together.

rows.Speaker: Kuromiya
rows.Line: However, we won't really be able to do anything that requires getting food or souvenirs from elsewhere...

rows.Speaker: Kuromiya
rows.Line:
Which points to a talk segment.
Would it be possible for you to introduce some fabulous destinations...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Fabulous destinations...?
Isn't that right up your alley, MYU?

rows.Speaker: Kuromiya
rows.Line: Feel free to talk about all the inns and hotels you like. We can always send some teams over to interview them at a later date.

rows.Speaker: MYU
rows.Line:
...
Okay, I understand.

rows.Speaker: MYU
rows.Line: I've uploaded a lot of stuff to PicShare, so they might not seem all that new or interesting to our viewers. But I guess we don't have a choice...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Right. MYU worked really hard on this segment for the sake of everybody watching...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It'd be awful to see all her hard work go to waste by becoming something incomplete...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (We don't have a choice but to change course here, but I feel like there's a better solution out there...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Something that more closely resembles MYU's original segment. Something that the audience will really enjoy...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, uhh... I just had an idea...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But it might not be a very good one since it really just popped into my head...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Why don't you start by telling us?
Your idea could very well give us the hint we need.

rows.Speaker: Kuromiya
rows.Line:
Yes, please tell us.
If your idea is better than the one I just suggested, then we'll go with that instead.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-Then, okay...!
So...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What if we introduced all the souvenirs that the TV station sells?

rows.Speaker: MYU
rows.Line: This station's souvenirs?

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line:
The gift shop here is open to the public.
Was your plan to introduce the stuff that we made on this show and the merchandise featuring this studio's mascots?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! I visited just the other day and thought it was really cool how this is the only place where you can get a lot of those things.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Doing a segment on this station's gift shop seemed really fun, and they already have everything we need.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-How does that sound...?!

rows.Speaker: MYU
rows.Line:
...
That could actually work.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Yuika
rows.Line:
I agree.
I feel like that's something MYU's followers could get behind.

rows.Speaker: MYU
rows.Line: I'm also really interested since I don't actually know what's available in the gift shop!

rows.Speaker: MYU
rows.Line:
So, let's go with Hanasato's idea.
We can call it something like... “Check Out All The Cool Stuff In The Station's Gift Shop!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You mean it...?!

rows.Speaker: Kuromiya
rows.Line: Yes, we could get everything ready in no time and start a fun conversation viewers might not be expecting.

rows.Speaker: Kuromiya
rows.Line:
Let's go with her idea...
We'll just need some time to get set up.

rows.Speaker: Kuromiya
rows.Line:
Listen, everyone!
We need to be ready to shoot in thirty minutes!

rows.Speaker: TV Crew
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That was amazing, Minori...!
You came up with a wonderful idea in such a short amount of time!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I wasn't sure what was gonna happen, but I think you just saved the show...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-It really just popped into my head, but I'm glad I could help somehow!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, all that's left is to wait for them to get the set ready.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right!
So until then...

rows.Speaker: Audience Member's Voice
rows.Line: They said they were just having some technical issues, right? What's taking them so long...?

rows.Speaker: Audience Member's Voice
rows.Line:
Yeah, I hope they resume soon.
My bottom's starting to get a little sore...

rows.Speaker: Audience Member's Voice
rows.Line: Including the time they took to set up, we've been sitting for like three hours now... I knew that delays were possible, but nothing this long.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The audience has been waiting for quite a while now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and they're being asked to stay in their seats outside of breaks. Those aren't exactly what you'd call comfortable, either...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope our shoot resumes soon...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: TV Crew
rows.Line:
Excuse me, Mr. Arimura?
The writer just finished making edits to the script. Would you mind taking a look with the producer?

rows.Speaker: TV Crew
rows.Line: Let's take this opportunity to touch up your makeup, Yuika!

rows.Speaker: TV Crew
rows.Line: The set's still cluttered from before, so get it ready to start again! Also, cameras, check your positions!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The crew's scrambling to get ready, while I'm standing by doing nothing...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Isn't there a way for me to help...?
The crew, the audience, the other guests, anything...)

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: Hey, anyone free to go buy the souvenirs MYU needs from the gift shop?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm free!
I'll go buy them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll be right back!
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: Hey, thanks a bunch...

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: Wait, Hanasato...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Let's go with her.
She's probably going to need an extra hand.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
She's got the right idea.
We should follow her lead and also try to help.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I agree.
Let's tell the staff what's going on and go after her.
Several minutes later

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We're back!
And we've got all the gift shop's best-selling items!

rows.Speaker: MYU
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you so much.
I can't believe you actually went and got them for me.

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line:
Wait, how much did you buy?
I don't think we'll be able to get through all this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, these snacks are for the audience!

rows.Speaker: Yuika
rows.Line: The audience?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! We thought they deserved a reward for being so patient with us...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, we figured it'd be more fun for them if they got to have the same things we'll be having during the segment.

rows.Speaker: MYU
rows.Line: You've got everything covered...

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line:
Thank you very much...
But you really didn't have to do all this since it's technically the crew's job.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, uh... I-I'm sorry for running off like that! I know we still need to redo our makeup and stuff...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it just didn't feel right for us to do nothing while everyone else scrambled to get things ready...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And it really didn't seem right to keep the audience waiting for so long...!

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line: Yes, it's important to never forget that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Mr. Arimura...?

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line: You get into a habit of drawing lines when you're in a studio like this, but the crew and personalities all want the show they're working on to be good. We all want the audience to enjoy themselves.

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line: Which is why it's so important to take a step back, forget the lines in the sand and remind ourselves of what the audience is feeling.

rows.Speaker: Yuika
rows.Line: Yes, I agree...

rows.Speaker: MYU
rows.Line: I think you just taught us a valuable lesson, Hanasato. Your work ethic is beyond admirable.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: N-No, I just...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We still have some time left until we're supposed to resume, so how about we help pass these snacks out to the audience...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great idea! I'm sure they'll enjoy things even more if they get these from us personally.

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line: Yes, that would be a fun surprise.

rows.Speaker: Yuika
rows.Line:
Alright, let's do it!
I'll start from the back!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry about the delay, everyone!
We brought you a little treat for being so patient!

rows.Speaker: Audience Members
rows.Line: A treat?! For us...?!

rows.Speaker: MYU
rows.Line: We should be shooting again shortly, so we hope you'll enjoy these in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Audience Members
rows.Line:
MYU?! I can have this...?!
I'm a huge fan! I follow you on PicShare...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
The audience seems much happier now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I hope this makes up for forcing them to suffer through this delay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: All that's left is to wait for the crew to finish getting everything set up.

rows.Speaker: TV Crew
rows.Line:
Thank you all for your patience!
We're ready to roll! Please take your positions!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's get right back to it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's do everything we can to give the audience the show they really deserve!

rows.Speaker: Airi, Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!

source: https://storage.sekai.best/sekai-en-assets/event_story/…（SEKAI master database + SEKAI Viewer 资源，官方文本）
